“你知道！”那将臣一听，惊讶的说道。而说完之后，就后悔了。他知道，自己被那叶枫给套话了。

“你没事，我就没事。”这话，带了几分情意，偏他说得郑重其事，于是格外动人。

然而，观战看热闹的天仙们，又是深以为然地点点头，不错，得饶人处且饶人，此子未来必将是一尊惊天动地的大人物。

“终于要开始了吗？”泰妍伸着懒腰说道。“大家都没行程吗？好像都很悠闲的样子呢~”聆星看了看左右好奇的说道。

有很多非常搞笑的问题都被记者们问了出来，比如聆星在现实生活里面和允浩的关系是什么，和以前演戏的伙伴李胜基比起来哪一个更好。

“没有没有~”聆星谦虚的说道。金申英趁此机会又问了聆星和泰妍很多的问题。

五夫人没有见过谢灵芸这么强势的一面，是彻底的被噎的说不出话来了。

他仰天巨吼一声，披肩银发，肆意飞舞，沾上浑身飞溅的鲜血，似乎成了鲜红色的长发，远远地望过去，他竟然是像是个血人。

“闭嘴吧。”康正源做惯了刑官，气势上很威严，但此时听韩无畏废话，有点要破功。

而且都是一省的人，这里又是景区开发，造福后人，赖老出山不足为奇。

罹龙剑、恶鬼刀、缚龙索和定海神珠四大宝物静静的躲藏在四方神鼎的下方，躲避着无处不在的罹龙剑气，那一股股的凶戾之气、锋利之气，令四大器灵为之色变。

“大人，我是昨天来此的姬飒城今天能见到您很开心，不知道您是不是还记得我”姬飒城低下头，一脸卑躬屈膝的说道。

"Is it finally time to start?" Taeyeon said, stretching."Doesn't everyone have a schedule? They all seem to be taking it easy~" Lingxing looked around and said curiously.

There were many very funny questions asked by reporters, such as what is the relationship between Yeongsung and Yunho in real life, and who is better compared to his former acting partner Lee Seung-ki.

"No, no~" Lingxing said modestly.Kim Shin Young took this opportunity to ask Yeong Sung and Taeyeon many questions.

The Fifth Madam had never seen such a strong side of Xie Lingyun, and was completely choked and speechless.

He looked up to the sky and roared loudly, his silver hair shawl flying freely, and with the blood splashing all over his body, it seemed to turn into long bright red hair. Looking from a distance, he actually looked like a bloody man.

"Shut up." Kang Zhengyuan was used to being a torture officer and had a very dignified demeanor, but at this time, listening to Han Wuwei's nonsense made him feel a little uneasy.

And they are all from the same province, and this is a scenic spot developed to benefit future generations. It is not surprising that Lai Lao came out.

The four treasures of the Dragon Sword, the Evil Ghost Sword, the Dragon Binding Rope and the Dinghai Divine Pearl were quietly hidden under the Four Directions Divine Cauldron, avoiding the ubiquitous Dragon Sword Qi. The ferocious and sharp aura made the four great weapon spirits change their expressions.

"Sir, I am Ji Sa Cheng who came here yesterday. I am very happy to see you today. I wonder if you still remember me." Ji Sa Cheng lowered his head and said with a groveling look on his face.
